# deadline

In [EhosContract.Process](process-dsl.md), section `process`.

```elixir
deadline within
```

How long a run may take, from its first event to one it `ends_on`.

**Arguments**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `within` | `any` | yes |  | `{n, unit}`, in a fixed unit. |

**Options**

| Name | Type | Required | Default | Docs |
|------|------|----------|---------|------|
| `unverified` | `boolean` |  | `false` | Not confirmed by the process owner. |
